s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive abdominal mass with obstructive jaundice and hemobilia
salient_findings: Progressive enlargement of the right-lobe mass
Obstruction of the right hepatic bile duct
key_facts: History of partial resection of a presumed benign hepatic lesion
Multiple sessions of transcatheter arterial embolization (TAE) for hemobilia
Six episodes of hemobilia treated with TAE
Alpha-fetoprotein and PIVKA-II within normal limits
Liver edge palpable four fingerbreadths below the xiphoid process
10 × 15 cm multilocular oval mass with papillary infoldings in the right hepatic lobe on abdominal ultrasonography
